'''The Dome''' was the largest structure at [[The Puddle]]. It was a fabric structure that maintained its shape using a low-pressure pump. The Dome had an open internal space, with several enclosed rooms along the inner perimeter. The fabric was translucent, allowing filtered light to penetrate in the daylight. Tinted fabric windows ringed the structure at a height of three [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="HS" />
